items.textToSpeech: For children under 14, the Tolerable Upper Intake Levels for nickel are as follows. 0.2 milligrams per day for those aged 1 to 3 years. 0.3 milligrams per day for those aged 4 to 8 years. and 0.6 milligrams per day for those aged 9 to 13 years. The Tolerable Upper Intake Level is the highest average daily nutrient intake level likely to pose no risk of adverse health effects to almost all individuals in a given life-stage and gender group. The Tolerable Upper Intake Level is not a recommended level of intake. As intake increases above the Tolerable Upper Intake Level, the potential risk of adverse effects increases. Is there anything else I can help you with?
